objective: Prevent optional model-profile prompts from distracting or interrupting the user's requested work while preserving explicit per-project model selection when delegation needs it.
requested: avoid a model-selection speed bump that delays or displaces the user's original instruction
excluded: silently change model choices beyond the user's stated preference
remove profile selection when an actual role assignment needs a model

requestedItems.description: Do not present a model-profile card solely because a substantial task has no delegation; present it when an actual delegation/model assignment is imminent or when user requests model advice.
A user's model/profile answer must not replace, restart, or pause unfinished work; save the scoped choice and continue the existing task.
If the original task is already complete when the user answers, acknowledge completion and apply only the requested profile change without inventing follow-up work.

acceptance.description: Global entrypoint, model policy and execution allocation agree on a non-blocking, work-first trigger for model cards.
Affected model-policy and functional-assurance verifiers pass; replay contract documents the observable boundaries and remaining runtime limits.
